visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed background image or muted looping background video with overlaid H1, intro paragraph and optional CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed background-image hero with overlaid text is a block (background belongs to the block).
visualCharacteristics.article: Blog article hero: optional uppercase pretitle, H1 (70px/84px at desktop, max 879px), optional subtitle and pill CTA, left-aligned over a -90deg black-to-transparent gradient; 908px tall at desktop. Without an image it falls back to the no-image navy gradient.

contentPattern.description: H1 'Innovating portfolios. Focused on outcomes.' + paragraph over full-bleed background image
contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image (poster) and/or link to an .mp4 video (same row or its own row); last row: H1 title, paragraph, optional CTA link
rows: Background image (optional when a video is set; used as poster)
contentPattern.article: text row: optional pretitle paragraph, H1 title, optional subtitle paragraph, optional CTA (bold link)

usage.description: Top-of-page hero with a photographic background and overlaid headline.

reuseGuidance: Use for any page-opening hero where text sits over a full-width photo. Use a plain heading (default content) when there is no background image. Use the article option for blog/insight article headers (pretitle, long title, subtitle, CTA).

backgroundVideo.detect: <video> element or link ending in .mp4 in a media-only row
backgroundVideo.behavior: muted, autoplay, loop, playsinline; image used as poster
backgroundVideo.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce shows the image only (no autoplay); without an image the video renders paused
